summary.text: Alex McMenemy is the Green Party nominee for the open 38th District. In his Ballotpedia survey he says his campaign calls for free universal health care, a $20 minimum wage, stronger unions and environmental protections, ending ICE, and ending foreign wars. Little other biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: McMenemy advanced from the Green Party convention for the 38th District on March 14, 2026, and completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2025.
In that survey he names homelessness as the issue he is personally most passionate about.
